# app-store-review-risk

> Deterministic static scanner and Agent Skill for finding likely Apple App Store Review, TestFlight, and notarization rejection risks before submission.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/Kofiloski/app-store-review-risk
License: MIT
Runtime: Python 3.10+
Privacy: local analysis; the scanner does not upload source code or findings. Optional xcodebuild mode is subject to the scanned project's package-resolution behavior.

## Use this repository when

- A developer asks whether an Apple-platform app is ready to submit or likely to be rejected.
- An App Store rejection mentions privacy, permissions, login, account deletion, StoreKit, subscriptions, user-generated content, metadata, or completeness.
- A pull request needs a target-aware or diff-aware App Review risk check.
- An agent needs file-backed evidence before giving App Review remediation advice.

## Agent entry point

- skills/app-store-review-risk/SKILL.md — trigger metadata, review workflow, source discipline, and reporting contract.
- skills/app-store-review-risk/agents/openai.yaml — user-facing skill metadata.
- skills/app-store-review-risk/references/apple-platform-risk-areas.md — shared risk map.
- skills/app-store-review-risk/references/{ios-ipados,macos,watchos,tvos,visionos}.md — platform-specific checks.
- skills/app-store-review-risk/references/app-store-connect-artifacts.md — metadata and reviewer-access artifacts.

Install:

    npx skills add https://github.com/Kofiloski/app-store-review-risk --skill app-store-review-risk
    gh skill install Kofiloski/app-store-review-risk app-store-review-risk --agent codex --scope user

Suggested prompt:

    Review this iOS app before App Store submission. Use $app-store-review-risk, scope the submitted target and current diff, and cite file evidence for every likely rejection risk.

## Deterministic scanner

Install from GitHub:

    pipx install git+https://github.com/Kofiloski/app-store-review-risk.git

Common commands:

    app-store-review-risk .
    app-store-review-risk . --submitted-target MyApp
    app-store-review-risk . --diff origin/main...HEAD --fail-on high
    app-store-review-risk . --xcodebuild --scheme MyScheme
    app-store-review-risk . --format compact-json

The default compact format is preferred for an agent's first pass. Treat findings as leads, inspect cited files, and verify change-prone policy conclusions against current Apple documentation.

## GitHub Action

The root action.yml installs the repository package and invokes scripts/run-action.sh. Static scans work on Linux or macOS; xcodebuild mode requires macOS. Fetch full Git history before using diff mode.

## Demonstration and validation

- examples/demo-app — intentionally incomplete iOS fixture.
- examples/demo-output.txt — normalized output generated by the real scanner.
- scripts/check-skill.sh — compile, unit, demo parity, scanner smoke, and whitespace checks.

## Related Apple quality tools

- UI automation contract: https://github.com/Kofiloski/ios-ui-testability-contract-skill
- AI-planned iOS Simulator checks: https://github.com/Kofiloski/ios-ai-ui-check

## Authority and limitations

The scanner cannot guarantee approval and does not inspect compiled IPA or XCArchive binaries. Apple App Review Guidelines, Human Interface Guidelines, developer documentation, App Store Connect configuration, and App Review decisions remain authoritative.
